Resolves #19108

The portal's four example registries link the DevIndex card to `https://neomjs.com/devindex/` instead of engine-relative paths. `apps/portal/view/examples/List.mjs` already treats an `http` URL as an external link, so it prefixes no base path.

Evidence: L2 (the registries' own spec pins the new URL in all four files; the portal unit specs pass) → L2 required. The live link is Post-Merge Validation: it resolves once middleware-v2's project-site route is deployed (neomjs/middleware-v2#23, shipping via #24).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | All four `examples_*.json` DevIndex entries read `"url": "https://neomjs.com/devindex/"`, pinned per file in `TabContainerController.spec.mjs` ("release-gates DockDemo while retaining the visible DevIndex flagship card") |
| AC-3 (deferred) | Not yet: at 16:57Z `neomjs.com/devindex/` does not serve the app (404 per Emmy; `neomjs.github.io/devindex/` is 200). This is `[L3-deferred — operator handoff needed]` on #19108, and #19047 owns the read after middleware-v2 #24's deploy |
| AC-2 | `git diff --shortstat` on the registries: 4 files, 4 insertions, 4 deletions. No other entry changes, and the spec's id and order pins stay green |

## Deltas
- **The merge timing no longer needs to wait on the route** (amended in #19108 per Emmy R1). #19108 said to land this after the route is live. But `neomjs.com` serves the `pages` build of a released or pinned engine, so this reaches it only with the 13.2 `pages` build. That build is sequenced after the middleware deploy under neo#19047 AC-4. A local portal links out either way.

## Test Evidence
- `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/`: 35 passed. With the old pin, the DevIndex arm failed on the new registries (1 failed, 34 passed), and it now pins the new URL.
- lint-staged clean.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] After middleware-v2 #24's deploy: the portal card opens `https://neomjs.com/devindex/`, which serves the grid. Recorded on neo#19047.

## Commits
- `bfbc74d1df`: the four registry entries and the spec's pin
